name: mac-genie
blurb: macOS dock with magnified icons and genie window animations.
description: Renders a macOS-style dock with spring-based icon magnification on hover. Clicking an icon opens a window with a canvas-based genie animation that morphs between dock and open position, mirroring macOS behavior.
use_when: Showcasing a premium macOS-inspired interface or demonstrating canvas-based animation combined with Framer Motion physics.
avoid_when: Touch devices; the hover magnification requires pointer tracking. Needs a sized container for proper layout.
a11y: Keyboard navigation not supported. Window open/close buttons lack keyboard accessibility. Animations do not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
